scripts.build: npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:widget
scripts.check: node -e "import('vite').then(async({transformWithEsbuild})=>{const fs=await import('node:fs/promises');const files=['vite.config.js','vite.widget.config.js'];for(const d of ['api','src'])for(const f of await fs.readdir(d,{recursive:true}))if(/[.](jsx?|mjs)$/.test(f))files.push(d+'/'+f);for(const f of files){await transformWithEsbuild(await fs.readFile(f,'utf8'),f);console.log('syntax ok: '+f)}}).catch(e=>{console.error(String(e.message||e));process.exit(1)})"
scripts.check:build: node -e "import('node:fs/promises').then(async fs=>{const read=async f=>fs.readFile(f,'utf8').catch(()=>'');const bad=[];for(const f of ['dist/index.html','extensions/virtual-try-on/assets/virtual-try-on.js','extensions/virtual-try-on/assets/virtual-try-on.css'])if(!(await read(f)).trim())bad.push('missing or empty: '+f);if(!(await read('dist/index.html')).includes('/assets/'))bad.push('dist/index.html does not link a bundled entry script');if((await read('extensions/virtual-try-on/assets/virtual-try-on.js')).includes('process.env'))bad.push('widget bundle references process.env, it would throw in the storefront');for(const m of bad)console.error(m);if(bad.length)process.exit(1);console.log('build output ok')})"
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm run build && npm run check:build
